verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.tavily.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with agent-oriented content, and the docs also publish llms-full.txt. There is a dedicated agents.md stating every docs page is served as clean Markdown by appending .md, and a keyless documentation MCP server (hosted by Mintlify) for searching and reading the docs. A SKILL.md agent-setup instruction lets a coding agent install and configure Tavily itself, so every element of the story is covered with first-party docs and hands-on corroboration.
